create.name: Zen Zentrum Berlin (Chong Hye Sah)
create.bio:
The Zen Zentrum Berlin, known by its Korean temple name Chong Hye Sah, opened in the spring of 1990 in the Wedding district of the city. It is the headquarters of the Kwan Um Zen School in Germany and, since 2008, has also been the head temple of the Kwan Um School across Europe. Its practice follows Zen Master Seung Sahn, the Korean teacher who founded the school, and its guiding teacher is Zen Master Gu Ja (Namhee Chon), who joins evening sittings and gives kong-an interviews.

Morning practice of bowing, chanting and sitting runs on weekdays from 5:30, and on two evenings a week there is a longer sitting, with dharma talks on the first and third Tuesday and interviews on alternate Fridays. Newcomers start with a short introduction to Korean Zen meditation, offered without booking before the evening session, and many sittings can also be followed on Zoom. Up to six students can live in the temple and train there, joining the daily schedule and a monthly retreat. Weekend retreats with authorised teachers and an online beginners' course in German and English complete the programme.

courses.title: YMJJ with Zen Master Gu Ja
courses.description: A weekend silent retreat (Yong Maeng Jong Jin) at the Berlin temple led by Zen Master Gu Ja, with sitting, chanting, work practice and kong-an interviews, followed by a precepts ceremony.

courses.title: Online Zen-Kurs für Einsteiger
courses.description: A seven-week beginners' course on Zoom, taught by a dharma teacher of the German school in German and English, introducing several forms of Zen meditation on Tuesday evenings.

courses.title: Temple stay: living and practising at the Zen Zentrum Berlin
courses.description: Residential Zen training for up to six students, who rent a furnished room and join weekday morning practice, two evening sittings a week and a monthly retreat, after a month of regular visits and a two-week trial stay.

free_resources.title: Einführung in die Meditation
free_resources.description: A short introduction to Korean Zen meditation for first-time visitors before the evening sitting, with no booking needed, followed by the regular evening practice (in person or on Zoom).
